queries.not_categorized_pool: select star_id,max(kepmag) as kepmag,count(quarter) as available_quarters,min(ra) as ra,min(dec) as dec,min(eff_temp) as effective_temperature_k,min(radius) as stellar_radius_solar from keplertimeseries where object_status=0 and targettype='long cadence     ' and kepmag between 10.0 and 15.0 group by star_id
queries.all_koi_ids: select kepid,kepoi_name,koi_disposition from cumulative where kepid is not null
queries.confirmed_kepler_ids: select kepid,kepler_name from keplernames where kepid is not null

selection_method: ascending SHA-256 of '<seed>:<KIC>'; independent of light-curve signal
